visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An Asian male in a brown jacket stands in profile on a grey, rocky beach. He gazes at powerful, frothy waves crashing under a cloudy, muted sky. The lighting is natural but gloomy. He remains still with a pensive expression, his profile silhouetted against the bright white foam of the sea. (2) The scene shifts rapidly to a night sky filled with vivid fireworks of green, yellow, and red blooming repeatedly. This cuts to a dense crowd of hundreds of people on a city street at night, looking at distant urban buildings lit with purple neon lights under a dark, overcast sky. (3) A sequence of diverse environments follows: a city gas station with bright red and blue signage at night, Taipei 101 with golden fireworks exploding around its peak, a train window view of suburban houses at dusk, and silhouetted birds flying over a calm sea at sunset. The lighting varies from dark night to warm dusk. (4) The final phase shows the man back at the initial beach location. He turns his face towards the lens, maintaining a soft, pensive expression against the backdrop of the white sea foam and the expansive, horizon-less ocean under the same grey, natural daylight.

visual_human_presence.countingEvidence: 1 main male character at the beach; a massive crowd of people in the night street scenes.
visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: An Asian male with short black hair, wearing a dark green sweater under a brownish-orange zip-up jacket.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The video features multiple locations: a rugged coastline with grey crashing waves, a city street with neon-lit buildings and large crowds, a tall skyscraper (Taipei 101) with fireworks, a view from a moving train at twilight, and a misty forested mountain range.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with the distinct, broad-spectrum splashing sound of ocean waves crashing onto a shore. A gentle, resonant piano starts playing a mid-tempo major-key melody. A male voice enters, singing in a calm, melodic Mandarin with a moderate speech rate and friendly, intimate tone. (2) As the visuals transition to fireworks and crowds, a full drum kit and acoustic guitar enter the mix, significantly increasing the volume and rhythmic intensity. The singer's pitch rises into a higher register, and the vocal intensity increases to a projected, high-arousal level with more dynamic intonation. (3) The music maintains a driving pop-ballad feel with a steady beat. The vocal articulation is crisp and professional, reaching a climax in terms of volume and emotional delivery. Ambient noises are completely ducked under the music production, which dominates the spectral balance. (4) Toward the end, the instrumentation strips back, returning to the isolated, low-frequency rumble of the ocean waves. The singer's voice fades on a lingering, soft note. The track ends with a clean fade-out of the ambient natural wave noise, mirroring the beginning's structure.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Circular: Home/Self -> World/Journey -> Return to Home/Self
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a lyrical and visual reflection on personal growth, identity, and the passage of time. By contrasting the solitary man at the beach with bustling city scenes and festive fireworks, it highlights the internal dialogue between one's current state and their aspirations. The integration of Taipei landmarks and moving transport metaphors suggests a journey of soul-searching.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses a high-quality music track as its primary narrative driver, with visual cuts synchronized to the beat. The circular structure and rhetorical subtitles suggest a self-reflective theme typical of modern independent music videos.
